auditMethod: Verify exact rawReport hash and declaration. Observation and ledger order are copied without selection. For each observation, partition raw inventory.identities by (kind, sorted categories), sum counts and 24/32-byte header terms once per identity, union its reasons, and select the shortest-path representative plus shortest multiple-path witness when distinct. Representative IDs/paths/reasons are literal raw records; no graph is rebuilt. All budget scalars and statuses are copied; threshold screens are derived only for positive delta.
